issues.legal_issue: A proceeding commenced under a law before its repeal may continue in the original court when the repeal does not clearly displace pending proceedings and a later saving provision preserves them.
material_facts: The mortgagor’s successor filed an application to redeem a usufructuary mortgage under the then-applicable law before the repeal was given effect.
The repeal operated retrospectively only from a date after the application was filed.
The new law did not provide for pending proceedings to be transferred to the newly empowered court.
When a later amendment expressly preserved pending proceedings and appeals, the matter was still pending on appeal.
issues.conclusion: The original court had jurisdiction to continue and decide the proceeding under the old law; the repeal and the new court’s jurisdiction did not render it incompetent.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 6(c) and (e) of the U.P. General Clauses Act, unless a different intention appears, repeal does not affect accrued rights or remedies and does not prevent the continuation and conclusion of proceedings commenced before repeal. The court found no contrary intention in the U.P. Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act or its 1953 amendment: the repeal was not retrospective to a time before the proceeding began, and there was no provision transferring pending cases. Section 23 of the 1956 amending Act expressly preserved proceedings and appeals already pending, confirming that they continued under the old law. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: redemption_proceeding and commenced_before_repeal_took_effect and repeal_did_not_reach_before_commencement and no_transfer_of_pending_proceedings and pending_when_later_saving_applied

predicates.redemption_proceeding: A party commenced a proceeding to redeem a mortgage under the law then in force.
predicates.commenced_before_repeal_took_effect: The party commenced the proceeding before the repeal took effect.
predicates.repeal_did_not_reach_before_commencement: The repeal did not operate from a time earlier than the commencement of the proceeding.
predicates.no_transfer_of_pending_proceedings: The new law did not direct that pending proceedings be transferred to another court or authority.
predicates.pending_when_later_saving_applied: The proceeding or its appeal remained pending when a later enactment expressly preserved pending proceedings.

issues.definition: When a redemption proceeding began before repeal, the repeal did not reach back before its commencement, no transfer of pending proceedings was provided for, and a later saving applied while the matter remained pending, the proceeding continues under the old law.
